thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P-98123 triggered for inference.prod.redwood.com — high 5xx error rate (6.2% over 2m). Impact: production text-gen API returning 503s for some customers. PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-98123

pagerduty-bot: PD policy SRE-Prod-Oncall fired. Primary: maya paged. Escalation sequence: maya -> ben (secondary) -> olivia (manager). Paging now.

kartik: seeing spike in Grafana: endpoint /v1/generate 95th p50 stable but 95th latency and 5xxs spiking in prod-1 cluster. Noticed a surge after 09:12 UTC.

maya: oncall here — getting notification. looking. can you paste example logs?

kartik: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z api-service[pid=32]: ERROR handler.go:142 status=503 model=redwood-xl msg="kv-cache miss and inference timeout"
2026-03-14T09:12:08Z api-service[pid=32]: WARN rate_limiter.go:78 burst=240 reqs=512
```

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: maya has not acknowledged within 60s — escalating to ben (secondary).

ben: got the page but my phone is on DND — just saw the alert now, trying to connect to VPN. remote right now, might be 3-5m.

oncall-manager (olivia): pd escalation fired to manager because secondary not acked in window. paging me now. I'm jumping on this.

olivia: quick customer impact check — which tenants seeing 503s? kartik can you run a query for error distribution by tenant?

kartik: running query... result: 18 unique customers affected, top 3 by volume: acme-corp (40%), beta-app (18%), internal-test (12%). Error rate for acme-corp ~12% over last 2m.

olivia: OK good to know. mitigation plan: 1) try rolling restart of api-service in prod-1 2) if restart doesn't help, fail traffic to prod-2 and enable model fallback to redwood-small for burst traffic 3) keep customers informed.

ben: i'm in VPN now. i'll try to run readiness checks and restart one replica to validate.

ben: helm list shows api-service v3.4.2 on prod-1. running: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/api-service --record`

kartik: watch logs for errors during restart: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/api-service -f --since=5m`

ben: rolling restart initiated. restarting pods one at a time.

maya: FYI I forwarded this PD to workspace #customers to give a heads up. posted short note: "We are investigating increased 503s on text-gen API. SRE triaging."

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: primary did not acknowledge in window before escalation; secondary initially delayed but now active; manager on-call joined.

ben: first pod restarted fine, second pod crashed on init — OOM kill in inference runtime during model load. attaching snippet:
```
[OOM] container api-runtime pid=222 memory=3.8G limit=3.6G msg="alloc failed"
```

sre-lead: that looks like a model load memory regression. Did we push new model quantization settings last deploy?

kartik: recent deploy earlier today included a quantization change on redwood-xl to prefer int8 fallback on some GPUs. rolling back config might help.

olivia: short-term: scale up nodes to give headroom and shift some traffic to prod-2. Ben, can you scale up the node pool and re-run restart?

ben: scaling node pool +2 for prod-1: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-prod-1 --size=8` — started. triggering new pods to schedule.

ben: second pod came up after additional memory, health checks passing. errors dropping. 5xx rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% in last 90s.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P-98123 acknowledged by ben at 09:19:51 UTC.

olivia: good. keep monitoring for 10m. who will own the postmortem? we need to investigate the quantization change + model load memory behavior.

maya: I can lead the postmortem with kartik and ben. I'll draft the initial timeline.

ben: brief communications: please notify acme-corp support channel that we've mitigated the issue and are doing follow-up.

maya: sending note to support: "Issue mitigated; SRE is investigating root cause. We'll update within 24h."

kartik: monitoring shows 5xx at 0.4% now and latency normalized. continuing to watch.

olivia: marking incident as mitigated in Slack at 09:32:10 UTC and updating PD. follow-up tasks: rollback quantization change on canary, add model-load mem check in deploy pipeline, postmortem assigned to maya/ben/kartik.

incident-bot: Incident P-98123 status: mitigated. Postmortem required. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-98123

ben: handing back oncall to maya — I'm available if needed.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll create the postmortem doc and ping for review. closing thread after PM created. :thumbsup:
